Special Redevelopment Agency
AGENDA
la puente Special Redevelopment Agency
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
September 13, 2006
07:28 PM
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
BOARD MEMBERS: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Perez, and Chavez
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
NEW BUSINESS
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR ACQUISITION AND RELOCATION SERVICES
It is recommended that the Redevelopment Agency award the contract to Paragon Partners, Ltd. and adopt a resolution transferring funds in an amount not to exceed $194,000.
ADJOURNMENT
Copies of reports relating to items on the Agenda are available for public inspection or purchase at City Hall. Questions regarding agenda items may be addressed to the City Clerk at 626/855-1500, extension 538. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk’s Office. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
* Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727, effective September 7, 1995.)

Special Redevelopment Agency MINUTES
of the
La Puente Special Redevelopment Agency
Meeting
September 13, 2006
A Meeting of the Redevelopment Agency of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on 09/13/2006, at 07:30 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
NEW BUSINESS
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR ACQUISITION AND RELOCATION SERVICES
Lujan moved to autorize the Redevelopment Agency award the contract to Paragon Partners, Ltd. and adopt a resolution to increase the budget for contract services by $217,800; seconded by Perez.
The motion carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Perez, Lujan, and Chavez. NOES: Storing, and Solis.
ADJOURNMENT
____________________________
Carol Cowley, Secretary
______________________________
Renee Chavez, Chairwoman
